scripts.install:all: npm install && cd apps/api && uv sync
scripts.dev:api: cd apps/api && uv run uvicorn app.main:app --reload --host 127.0.0.1 --port 8000
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck -w apps/web && cd apps/api && uv run mypy app tests
scripts.test: npm run test -w apps/web && cd apps/api && uv run pytest
